A New Jersey state program that helps families pay medical expenses for a child that are not covered by insurance or other programs. Expenses must have been incurred before the child's 22nd birthday and within the seven years before applying.

Expenses must exceed 10% of the first $100,000 of annual family income, plus 15% of any income above that amount. The child must have lived in New Jersey for at least three months before applying.
